environments.native: Ubuntu24.04 x86_64 VPS, kernel6.8,8vCPU,8GiB; same cross-built Linux test executables, GOMAXPROCS=2; benchmark and race processes in isolated loopback-only network namespaces
environments.native_race: Linux race binary built on Debian12 with Go1.27.4 and run on Ubuntu24.04; compatible glibc runtime; no toolchain installed on the VPS

noise_record.scope: 32KiB payload, encryption plus framed receive/decryption in memory; emulated Linux, not a network speed figure

relay_logging.scope: 64KiB logical chunk sent to no-op writer; measures disabled-Tracef dispatch, not memory bandwidth or network throughput

native_long_method.metric: aggregate bidirectional tunnel Mbit/s; both endpoints, backend and driver in one process; loopback only

short_sample_limit: Earlier 4MiB x2 trials allocated receiver buffers per transfer and lasted only tens of milliseconds for native TCP modes. Retained for completeness, not proof of universal speed improvement. KCP/QUIC have these short comparative measurements only.

correctness.ordinary_reverse_ipv6: same10 modes plus IPv6 fallback passed
correctness.forwarded_udp: Basic datagram echo in all9 stream modes passed, including WSS,WSSmux,Stealth. Boundary stress checked via TCPmux; source separation checked via the shared forwarding path.
correctness.concurrency_and_auth: concurrent/sequential forwarding, incorrect-token refusal, fallback, restart and partition checks passed
correctness.privileged_reverse: XDI and PCK, two namespaces,256KiB each direction byte-identical; test script requires both separate network and mount namespaces
correctness.direct_l3: 12 real-TUN/GRE scenarios passed: UDP one/two paths, QUIC,PCK,SNI,XDI,Spoof; listener restarts; PCK one-way flow block; UDP/QUIC20ms1%loss.5MiB transfers byte-identical. Spoof is a direct carrier, not a supported reverse transport.
correctness.mixed_release: 20 old-server/new-client and new-server/old-client checks across the10 ordinary modes passed; peer reference was v0.1.1

race.targeted_network_and_relay: passed in Linux; includes partial receive, tampered records, padding/legacy compatibility and WebSocket cancellation
race.native_all_mode_e2e: passed:10-mode establishment/data matrix,9-mode forwarded UDP matrix,WSS/WSSmuxTLS data plane; no data races detected
race.emulated_initial_and_corrective: nonzero:KCP hit unchanged data/readiness deadlines, including rerun with2 Go workers and8MiB VM UDP ceilings. Preserve these failures; native execution of the same race cases passed.

other_checks.normal_handlers_package: passed excluding only TestTheRelayPoolStaysFree absolute timing gate, which is unsuitable for software emulation

remaining_limits: Only Stealth has a clear native sustained throughput gain in these samples. Non-Stealth ranges overlap and several candidate medians are lower; no universal speedup is claimed.
PCK recovery after blocking only the dialler-to-listener flow took156.2seconds; retained limitation, not fixed by these changes.
No new public Iran-abroad route, multi-hour stability or hardware-uplink capacity certification is claimed.
Raw carriers were tested on IPv4 in isolated namespaces; no raw-carrier IPv6 claim.
ARM64 is cross-built and scanned, not executed on ARM hardware.
